message: Quick-select weight chips now wrap in a FlowRow with the 100% chip first.

artifacts.summary: Reworked QuickWeightSelector from a horizontally scrolling LazyRow into a wrapping FlowRow chip group with the 100% chip in the leading position, extracting the ordering and selection rules into a testable pure function. Added 15 unit tests covering ordering, value resolution, selection states and spacing tokens; the full build and 562-test suite pass.
